uiuc:p:adaeze-okonkwo.bestFor: Students who want to actually learn data structures and are willing to put in the hours.
uiuc:p:adaeze-okonkwo.gradingNote: In 2 course(s) over 5 year(s), GPA averaged 3.08 (−0.09 vs. the same courses taught by others); 1.1% withdrew.
strengths: Lectures are consistently described as clear and well organized
Office hours and the course notes are called genuinely useful
Grading is seen as fair and transparent despite the difficulty
uiuc:p:adaeze-okonkwo.verdict: Across 23 reviews, students call Okonkwo demanding but exceptionally clear — expect heavy problem sets and exams that reward real understanding.
watchOuts: Workload is heavy; several reviews say the problem sets take most of the week
Exams are hard and averages run low before any curve
